source.modifications: Curated SRD spell metadata and short descriptions are structured and paraphrased for lookup. These are summaries, not the complete spell rules; follow the linked SRD and your DM for all requirements, exceptions, and upcasting. Added short paraphrased 2014 condition summaries for hover/reference use; they are explanatory only and never infer automation.
source.verification: SRD 5.1 official document; 2014 spell metadata also cross-referenced against the archived 5e-bits SRD database (commit c59553ae0d80d24f9801b21761aa7c851da28999).

spells.name: Acid Arrow
spells.description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.description: Acid damages one or two close creatures that fail Dexterity saves; base damage 1d6.

spells.name: Aid
spells.description: Your spell bolsters allies with toughness and resolve, increasing their hit point maximum and current HP.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.description: Sets an alarm against unwanted intrusion into a designated area.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.description: Change your form with aquatic adaptation, altered appearance, or natural weapons.

spells.name: Animal Friendship
spells.description: Attempt to convince a beast that you mean it no harm.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.description: Use a Tiny beast to deliver a message.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.description: Magically lock a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.description: Project yourself and up to eight willing creatures into the Astral Plane.

spells.name: Bane
spells.description: Up to three targets that fail Charisma saves subtract 1d4 from attacks and saves.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: Attempt to send a creature you can see to another plane of existence.

spells.name: Beacon of Hope
spells.description: Bestow hope and vitality on chosen creatures within range.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.description: Touch a creature and require a Wisdom save to avoid a curse.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spells.name: Blur
spells.description: Your body becomes blurred and hard to see clearly.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: Creatures in the cone take 3d6 fire damage, or half on a successful Dexterity save.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: Attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range.

spells.name: Command
spells.description: Speak a one-word command to a creature you can see.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.description: Understand the literal meaning of spoken language you hear.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: Attempt to interrupt a creature casting a spell.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.description: Create or destroy water within range.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: Heals a creature for 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier; scales by slot level.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.description: Create a sphere of magical darkness at a point within range.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.description: Grant a willing creature the ability to see in darkness.

spells.name: Daylight
spells.description: Create a large sphere of light at a point within range.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.description: Grant a creature protection against death.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.description: Sense certain creature types and consecrated or desecrated places nearby.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Sense nearby magic within 30 feet and inspect visible magical auras; ritual.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.description: Sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and disease nearby.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.description: Read the surface thoughts of certain creatures.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.description: Teleport yourself to another location within range.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.description: Change the apparent look of yourself and what you wear or carry.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: Attempt to end spells on a creature, object, or magical effect.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: Create a minor nature-based magical effect.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack for 1d10 force damage; gains more beams with level.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Grasping weeds and vines erupt within a square area.

spells.name: Expeditious Retreat
spells.description: Move at an increased pace using the Dash action.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.description: Illuminates targets that fail Dexterity saves; attacks against visible affected targets gain advantage.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.description: Slow the descent of up to five falling creatures.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.description: Summon a familiar spirit that takes an animal form.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d10 fire damage; can ignite unattended flammable objects.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: A 20-foot-radius blast deals 8d6 fire damage, half on a successful Dexterity save.

spells.name: Fly
spells.description: Grant a willing creature a flying speed for the duration.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.description: Create a sphere of obscuring fog.

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.description: Create an invisible prison made of magical force.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.description: Bestow limited foresight of the immediate future on a willing creature.

spells.name: Gaseous Form
spells.description: Transform a willing creature into a misty cloud.

spells.name: Glibness
spells.description: For the duration, Charisma checks can treat the d20 result as 15.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.description: Make yourself or a touched creature invisible for the duration.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: A willing creature adds 1d4 to one ability check before the spell ends.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.description: Ranged spell attack deals 4d6 radiant damage; next attack against target has advantage.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: Enhance a willing creature's speed and combat capabilities.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: Heals a visible creature for 1d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.description: Heat a visible manufactured metal object.

spells.name: Hex
spells.description: Add 1d6 necrotic damage on hits; chosen ability checks have disadvantage.

spells.name: Hideous Laughter
spells.description: A creature perceives everything as hilariously funny and may fall into laughter.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.description: Attempt to paralyze a creature you can see.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: Attempt to paralyze a humanoid creature you can see.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.description: Mark a target; weapon hits deal an extra 1d6 damage and tracking improves.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.description: Create a twisting pattern of colors that can charm and incapacitate creatures.

spells.name: Identify
spells.description: Learn the properties of a magical object or a spell affecting a creature.

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.description: Make a melee spell attack that deals necrotic damage.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description: Makes a creature invisible until the effect ends or it attacks/casts a spell.

spells.name: Jump
spells.description: Triple a touched creature's jump distance.

spells.name: Knock
spells.description: Unlock or unbar an object you can see in range.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.description: Ends one disease or one of blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned conditions.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.description: Cause a creature or object to rise and remain suspended.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: An object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for another 20 feet.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.description: Sense the direction toward an object familiar to you.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.description: Increase a touched creature's speed by 10 feet.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: Sets an unarmored willing target's base AC to 13 plus Dexterity modifier.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral hand manipulates unattended light objects at short range.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Three darts automatically deal 1d4+1 force damage each to visible targets.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.description: Magically influence up to twelve creatures with a suggested course of action.

spells.name: Mending
spells.description: Repairs a break or tear in an object, up to one foot in any dimension.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: Create a small sound or illusory image.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.description: Create three illusory duplicates to make yourself harder to strike.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.description: A radiant cylinder deals 2d10 radiant damage on failed Constitution saves; movable with an action.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.description: Nearby chosen creatures gain +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and cannot be tracked normally.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.description: Transform a visible creature into a different form.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.description: Up to six visible creatures regain 2d8 plus spellcasting ability modifier hit points.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.description: Perform a minor magical trick.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.description: Protect a willing creature against certain types of supernatural creatures.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.description: Purify nonmagical food and drink within a small area.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.description: A willing target adds 1d4 to one saving throw.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.description: Return a creature that died within the last minute to life.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: One target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 radiant damage; cover grants no benefit.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.description: Ward a creature against attacks.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: Create and hurl three fiery rays at targets.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.description: See invisible creatures and objects and into the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Sending
spells.description: Send a brief message to a familiar creature over any distance.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: Create an intense ringing noise that damages creatures and objects.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: Gain +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: A chosen creature gains +2 AC for the duration.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.description: Melee spell attack deals 1d8 lightning damage; the target cannot take reactions until its next turn.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.description: Create a visible illusory object, creature, or phenomenon.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Cause creatures to fall into magical slumber.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.description: Stabilizes a living creature at 0 hit points.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.description: Grant movement on walls and ceilings without using hands.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.description: Protective spirits damage creatures that fail Wisdom saves and slow affected movement.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.description: Make a willing creature resistant to nonmagical physical attacks.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.description: Magically suggest a course of activity to a creature.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: Transport yourself and up to eight willing creatures or an object to a destination.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: Manifest a minor supernatural wonder.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: Creatures make Constitution saves against 2d8 thunder damage and a possible push.

spells.name: Tiny Hut
spells.description: Create an immobile protective dome of magical force.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.description: Grant the ability to see things as they actually are.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: Target fails a Wisdom save, takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.description: Grant underwater breathing to up to ten willing creatures.

spells.name: Web
spells.description: Create an area of sticky webbing that can restrain creatures.

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.description: Create a magical zone that prevents deliberate lies when creatures fail a Charisma save.

equipment.name: Acid (vial)
equipment.description: Use an action to splash or throw as an improvised attack; a hit deals 2d6 acid damage.

equipment.name: Antitoxin (vial)
equipment.description: Grants advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour; ineffective for undead and constructs.

equipment.name: Ball bearings (bag of 1,000)
equipment.description: As an action, spread across a 10-foot square; a creature moving through normally risks falling prone (DC 10 Dexterity save).

equipment.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
equipment.description: As an action, spread across a 5-foot square; moving creatures risk taking 1 piercing damage and reduced speed (DC 15 Dexterity save).

equipment.name: Potion of healing
equipment.description: A standard potion restores 2d4 + 2 HP. Using it follows the 2014 item rule.

equipment.name: Rope, hempen (50 feet)
equipment.description: Rope has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

equipment.name: Rope, silk (50 feet)
equipment.description: Rope has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

equipment.name: Spellbook
equipment.description: A leather-bound book with 100 blank vellum pages for recording spells.

equipment.name: Tinderbox
equipment.description: Lighting a torch is an action; lighting a more difficult fire takes one minute.

equipment.name: Torch
equipment.description: Burns for 1 hour, shedding bright light for 20 feet and dim light for 20 more.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Cannot see and fails checks requiring sight. Its attacks have disadvantage; attacks against it have advantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: Cannot attack or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects. The charmer has advantage on social interaction checks with it.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: Cannot hear and fails ability checks requiring hearing.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.description: Has six cumulative severity levels. The penalties grow from disadvantage on checks through movement, attacks, saves and maximum HP; level six causes death. Track the level with the DM, not this on/off icon.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: Has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while the source of fear is in sight; cannot willingly move closer to that source.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: Speed becomes zero; it gains no movement bonuses. The grapple may end when the grappler is incapacitated or the target is moved beyond reach.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.description: Cannot take actions or reactions. Other conditions may add further restrictions.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: Cannot be seen without special senses or magic. Its attacks generally have advantage; attacks against it generally have disadvantage. Actual perception and positioning still matter.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Incapacitated; cannot move or speak. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks against it have advantage, and hits from within 5 feet are critical.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: Transformed into a solid substance; incapacitated, unable to move or speak, unaware, and restrained. Has resistance to all damage and immunity to poison and disease under the 2014 rules.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: May crawl or spend movement to stand. Its own attacks have disadvantage; attacks from within 5 feet have advantage, while farther attacks have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: Speed is zero. Its attacks have disadvantage, attacks against it have advantage, and its Dexterity saving throws have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: Incapacitated; cannot move and can speak only falteringly. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attackers have advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: Incapacitated, unaware, unable to move or speak, and prone; drops held items. Fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attackers have advantage, and hits within 5 feet are critical.
